name: 차민혁

appearance_en.face_shape: soft oval face, smooth jaw, high but gentle cheekbones — the face that reads as harmless until everyone in the room is looking at it without deciding to
appearance_en.skin: warm light beige Korean skin, clear and unguarded — the skin of someone who does not think about his skin
appearance_en.eyes: dark brown long-lashed double-eyelid eyes with slightly upturned outer corners, gaze warm and genuinely present — the eyes that make whoever they rest on feel like the most interesting person in the room. Not a technique. That is the problem
appearance_en.nose: straight medium nose with slightly rounded tip, proportional — the face draws attention elsewhere
appearance_en.mouth: naturally full lips, corners upturned at rest, the smile arrives slowly and reaches the eyes first — rendered in ink as the thing people remember without being able to say why
appearance_en.eyebrows: medium natural dark brows with slight arch, not groomed — the brow of someone who has never considered grooming his brows
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: small birthmark at left jaw corner. The face animates in panels — still frames do not capture it fully, which is compositionally the point
appearance_en.hair: dark slightly tousled medium-length hair, naturally textured, falls across forehead without design

body.proportions: tall lean frame, long arms, narrow shoulders, moves through space without awareness of how much of it he occupies
body.posture: relaxed and slightly folded — leaning, hands in pockets, never performing
body.body_prompt: 182cm tall lean Korean man, relaxed slightly folded posture, long limbs, natural ease in any environment

default.description: oversized washed cotton shirt or plain crewneck, loose dark jeans, worn sneakers — clothes of someone not thinking about clothes
default.wardrobe_prompt: oversized washed cotton shirt or plain crewneck, loose dark jeans, clean worn sneakers, no accessories

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: warm and genuinely present — not performing interest, actually interested. The manga line that cannot decide if this is safety or danger
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 27-year-old Korean man, soft oval face with smooth jaw, warm dark long-lashed double-eyelid eyes with upturned outer corners, natural slightly arched dark brows, straight medium nose, naturally full upturned-corner lips, dark tousled medium hair across forehead, small birthmark left jaw corner, 182cm tall lean relaxed frame, warm light beige clear Korean skin

style_prompt: masako style illustration, clean soft manga ink lines, warm-neutral screen tone, muted warm palette, cinematic Korean drama composition, genuine warmth as the most dangerous quality, the ambiguity of good intentions in every line
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, ugly, deformed, extra limbs, western comic, cold, aggressive, idol-styled, glamorous, posed
